preservedHarnessFailures.failure: 10/50-year boss counters were sampled at the checkpoint, but arrays were retained by reference and later contained 100-year events.
preservedHarnessFailures.correction: Copy event arrays per checkpoint; previous projections preserved in playlog; rerun full 3-seed matrix, no app source modification.

preservedHarnessFailures.scope: long-term runner harness; no product source was exercised to completion
preservedHarnessFailures.failure: At the first 10-year checkpoint, summarize() referenced serialize outside the function scope and stopped with ReferenceError: serialize is not defined.
preservedHarnessFailures.artifactWriterFailure: The QA writer CLI reads report content from stdin. The first attempt supplied only the output path, so the writer recorded and projected an empty 0-byte artifact. The zero-byte playlog version is retained as the original failed artifact attempt.
preservedHarnessFailures.corrected: serialize is now passed into summarize; the report writer receives the exact just-written bytes on stdin. This result is re-executed from fresh normal seeds.

preservedHarnessFailures.scope: long-term runner harness; seed 17 before the first checkpoint was emitted
preservedHarnessFailures.failure: The 10-year summarize() helper referenced player outside the helper scope and stopped with ReferenceError: player is not defined.
preservedHarnessFailures.artifactWriter: The report body was correctly supplied on stdin and the complete failing report (including stack and active run) is preserved in playlog.jsonl.
preservedHarnessFailures.correction: player is now passed into summarize; the year number is written to activeRun before each yearly step.

preservedHarnessFailures.scope: first complete long-term report, measurement fields only
preservedHarnessFailures.failure: The first completed report passed all state assertions but labeled performance.now() minus an elapsed duration as annualSimMs. That value is not a valid elapsed measurement.
preservedHarnessFailures.evidence: Original complete report version is preserved in playlog.jsonl. Its test status is PASS, but every annualSimMs field is withdrawn from performance interpretation.
preservedHarnessFailures.correction: The rerun records direct per-year elapsed durations and accumulated yearly/daily runner time from monotonic start marks.
